decision: Do not promote v19. Limited original-color Rimebell door recovery does not meet wall/door acceptance.
user_priority: Actual walls and doors before fence experiments. No new fence experiment or fence label was made in this trial.

context_diagnostic.scope: Three models on four native maps: two training and two validation layouts, 14 annotated panels each. Oracle-centered 384px crops use known door checks; they cannot count as deployable candidate detection or an unbiased accuracy gain. Cropping changes context and patch-grid origin, so it does not isolate either cause. Final-test inputs absent.
context_diagnostic.result: No consistent recovery from centered crops. V18-best covers 4375/4455 training-panel pixels at 0.9 yet exports only 2/3 Frostwake and 4/7 Gilded checks. Correct interiors alone do not imply correct component boundaries or connected portals.

annotation_change.scope: Sixteen conservative source-selected floor/ground rectangles beside eight door checks on two training layouts, inspected in eight native-source/4x-raster pairs. Partial primary source-assisted annotations, not independently human-corrected complete truth. Unknown trim and uncertain junctions remain ignored. No model output supplies a label.
annotation_change.preflight_corrections: Regenerated checks inserted an explicit structure_free=false default; the corrected combined manifest reuses original check files exactly. A follow-up audit initially treated parsed legacy geometry dicts as paths; the complete 84-sample audit compares dicts directly. Both original artifacts remain retained. The new regression test's initial repository-parent path was also corrected and normalized for Linux CI.

training.comparison: Same v18 initializer, teacher, training recipe, sampling weights, class order, seed and six validation layouts. Only the added background supervision changes. Changed anchor locations can change sampled crops; not an exact paired-minibatch ablation.

native_evaluation.scope: 32 repeated checkpoint/color cases: six validation and two separate training-fit layouts, selected/final checkpoints, original/recolored appearance. Eight layouts, not 32 independent maps. Training fit is not generalization, partial native checks cannot establish full-map precision. Thresholds and runtime extraction unchanged; no reserved final-test input read.
findings: Selected Rimebell improves from 2/3 to 3/3 doors on the original, but remains 2/3 recolored. Final checkpoint gets 3/3 in both appearances.
Mothveil remains 0/1 door for both checkpoints and appearances. Source/geometry crops still show jagged wall predictions outside the clean wall strip.
Original Stone still exports an unmatched door: 2/4 truth matches from 3 predictions, with 19/20 legacy rays. The final recolored checkpoint passes only 18/20 Stone rays.
Final recolored Dyson loses its remaining door, 0/3 annotated matches and 11/14 legacy rays.
Training-fit doors remain incomplete: selected original Frostwake 2/3 and Gilded 4/7; selected recolored Frostwake 1/3 and Gilded 3/7.
Conservative nearby background additions alone are insufficient. This does not demonstrate a limitation of ML; it rejects this particular trial as a production improvement.

validation.live_foundry_world_import: Not rerun; this is a research/data/test update with no runtime or export change.

production.scope: Existing selected semantic-light model and settings retained. No inference speedup claimed by this training trial. The earlier door-jamb smoothing fix remains installed.
